name: pinpoint-email
description: Amazon Pinpoint Email Service Welcome to the Amazon Pinpoint Email API Reference.

subcommands.name: create-configuration-set
subcommands.description: Create a configuration set.

subcommands.name: create-configuration-set-event-destination
subcommands.description: Create an event destination.

subcommands.name: create-dedicated-ip-pool
subcommands.description: Create a new pool of dedicated IP addresses.

subcommands.name: create-deliverability-test-report
subcommands.description: Create a new predictive inbox placement test.

subcommands.name: create-email-identity
subcommands.description: Verifies an email identity for use with Amazon Pinpoint.

subcommands.name: delete-configuration-set
subcommands.description: Delete an existing configuration set.

subcommands.name: delete-configuration-set-event-destination
subcommands.description: Delete an event destination.

subcommands.name: delete-dedicated-ip-pool
subcommands.description: Delete a dedicated IP pool.

subcommands.name: delete-email-identity
subcommands.description: Deletes an email identity that you previously verified for use with Amazon Pinpoint.

subcommands.name: get-account
subcommands.description: Obtain information about the email-sending status and capabilities of your Amazon Pinpoint account in the current AWS Region.

subcommands.name: get-blacklist-reports
subcommands.description: Retrieve a list of the blacklists that your dedicated IP addresses appear on.

subcommands.name: get-configuration-set
subcommands.description: Get information about an existing configuration set, including the dedicated IP pool that it's associated with, whether or not it's enabled for sending email, and more.

subcommands.name: get-configuration-set-event-destinations
subcommands.description: Retrieve a list of event destinations that are associated with a configuration set.

subcommands.name: get-dedicated-ip
subcommands.description: Get information about a dedicated IP address, including the name of the dedicated IP pool that it's associated with, as well information about the automatic warm-up process for the address.

subcommands.name: get-dedicated-ips
subcommands.description: List the dedicated IP addresses that are associated with your Amazon Pinpoint account.

subcommands.name: get-deliverability-dashboard-options
subcommands.description: Retrieve information about the status of the Deliverability dashboard for your Amazon Pinpoint account.

subcommands.name: get-deliverability-test-report
subcommands.description: Retrieve the results of a predictive inbox placement test.

subcommands.name: get-domain-deliverability-campaign
subcommands.description: Retrieve all the deliverability data for a specific campaign.

subcommands.name: get-domain-statistics-report
subcommands.description: Retrieve inbox placement and engagement rates for the domains that you use to send email.

subcommands.name: get-email-identity
subcommands.description: Provides information about a specific identity associated with your Amazon Pinpoint account, including the identity's verification status, its DKIM authentication status, and its custom Mail-From settings.

subcommands.name: list-configuration-sets
subcommands.description: List all of the configuration sets associated with your Amazon Pinpoint account in the current region.

subcommands.name: list-dedicated-ip-pools
subcommands.description: List all of the dedicated IP pools that exist in your Amazon Pinpoint account in the current AWS Region.

subcommands.name: list-deliverability-test-reports
subcommands.description: Show a list of the predictive inbox placement tests that you've performed, regardless of their statuses.

subcommands.name: list-domain-deliverability-campaigns
subcommands.description: Retrieve deliverability data for all the campaigns that used a specific domain to send email during a specified time range.

subcommands.name: list-email-identities
subcommands.description: Returns a list of all of the email identities that are associated with your Amazon Pinpoint account.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Retrieve a list of the tags (keys and values) that are associated with a specified resource.

subcommands.name: put-account-dedicated-ip-warmup-attributes
subcommands.description: Enable or disable the automatic warm-up feature for dedicated IP addresses.

subcommands.name: put-account-sending-attributes
subcommands.description: Enable or disable the ability of your account to send email.

subcommands.name: put-configuration-set-delivery-options
subcommands.description: Associate a configuration set with a dedicated IP pool.

subcommands.name: put-configuration-set-reputation-options
subcommands.description: Enable or disable collection of reputation metrics for emails that you send using a particular configuration set in a specific AWS Region.

subcommands.name: put-configuration-set-sending-options
subcommands.description: Enable or disable email sending for messages that use a particular configuration set in a specific AWS Region.

subcommands.name: put-configuration-set-tracking-options
subcommands.description: Specify a custom domain to use for open and click tracking elements in email that you send using Amazon Pinpoint.

subcommands.name: put-dedicated-ip-in-pool
subcommands.description: Move a dedicated IP address to an existing dedicated IP pool.

subcommands.name: put-deliverability-dashboard-option
subcommands.description: Enable or disable the Deliverability dashboard for your Amazon Pinpoint account.

subcommands.name: put-email-identity-dkim-attributes
subcommands.description: Used to enable or disable DKIM authentication for an email identity.

subcommands.name: put-email-identity-feedback-attributes
subcommands.description: Used to enable or disable feedback forwarding for an identity.

subcommands.name: put-email-identity-mail-from-attributes
subcommands.description: Used to enable or disable the custom Mail-From domain configuration for an email identity.

subcommands.name: send-email
subcommands.description: Sends an email message.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Add one or more tags (keys and values) to a specified resource.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Remove one or more tags (keys and values) from a specified resource.

subcommands.name: update-configuration-set-event-destination
subcommands.description: Update the configuration of an event destination for a configuration set.
